feeds.title: Politik
feeds.description: 'Politik' draws on the 35 years of political journalism experience of Richard Harman. Best known as the Chief TVNZ Political Correspondent during the Muldoon, Lange and Bolger years, he went on to produce award-winning political documentaries and then established Front Page Ltd which pioneered weekend political interview shows with 'Agenda' and 'The Nation'.
